<!--
Thank you. This is the mechanism the whole protocol depends on: a methodology whose
author is also its only auditor cannot settle its own claims. Partial reports are
welcome — a single result on one mechanism is publishable. Disconfirming reports
are graded and published on the same scorecard as our own claims.
Anonymize freely: stack characteristics matter; project names do not.
-->
